artifact: Human-anchored precision for sweep-100 v5 (post ronda 5), inherited from the v3 adjudication
method: Ronda 5 only suppresses (never adds). Every v5 graded finding was matched to the v3 census by (rule,repo,file,line) and inherits its human verdict (project owner where sampled, external reviewer otherwise). Verified: 0 findings in v5 without a prior verdict; 0 findings new to v5; 0 unique v3-real findings lost. The graded universe shrank 257 -> 202 exclusively by suppressing inherited-false findings in the three rules targeted by ronda 5 (secret-in-code 47->18, secret-in-history 46->24, n8n 36->32); real counts per rule are unchanged or improved.

precision.false_mass_note: The 108 inherited-false findings carry the same human sample guarantee as the v3 measurement (0/60 reals found in the seeded false-stratum sample, Wilson upper 6%); if up to 6% of them were real, the pooled upper bound is ~49.7%.
